items.title: Mistral CEO Pushes Back: Energy Is “Not the Bottleneck” for AI Compute. Here’s What Is.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMistral CEO Arthur Mensch says energy is about 10% of AI compute’s cost and won’t be the bottleneck until 2029 or 2030. Mensch was talking about Europe, but Vistra’s CEO sees Texas power prices getting back on track on a similar 2029-2030 timeline.

items.title: Shortage of Turbines Drives Market for Second-Hand Market for AI Data Centers
items.summary: New gas turbines now take years to arrive, so AI data center developers are hunting for used machines and buying entire power plants. Five stocks sit on opposite sides of that scramble, and one of them is selling at a premium.

items.title: Trump Urges Senate to Make Data Centers “Pay for Their Own Electricity.” Power Builders Stand to Gain
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPresident Trump urged senators on Sunday to pass S. 5653, a permitting bill he says would speed up power plant construction and make data centers pay for their own electricity.

items.title: Nuke Stock Constellation Fueled By Earnings; NRG Hits Gas On Buybacks
items.summary: NRG will spend $1 billion more on buybacks thanks to an asset sale.

items.title: GE Vernova Soars 7% as Constellation Raises Guidance, Easing Data-Center Moratorium Fears
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares jumped 7% today, with Bloom Energy and Vertiv, after Constellation Energy beat estimates and raised its 2026 guidance. Constellation’s new deals show data-center buyers are still signing, so last week’s moratorium selloff looks overdone.

items.title: Tech stocks rally as Nvidia stock and oil prices fall: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Tech rallied as Nvidia shares dropped on Monday.

items.title: Data-Center Moratoriums? They Aren’t Showing Up in Constellation Energy’s Guidance.
items.summary: Constellation Energy raises full-year earnings guidance even as the U.S midterm elections have made some on Wall Street concerned the data-center buildout could stall.

items.title: Jensen Huang News Dominates Morning Headlines
items.summary: Shares of the world's largest corporation by market cap are down -6% on the news that NVIDIA CEO Huang had an affair with a Chinese spy.
